subject: Television & Streaming
title: Pose and Transgender Visibility
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Pose and Transgender Visibility.

hook.text: In 2018, FX's Pose featured the largest cast of transgender actors in television history.

buildup.text: Set in the New York ballroom scene of the 1980s, Pose told stories of transgender women of color navigating survival.

discovery.text: The show hired transgender writers, directors, and crew members.

twist.text: MJ Rodriguez became the first transgender actress nominated for a lead acting Emmy.

climax.text: Pose proved that authentic storytelling requires authentic voices.

punchline.text: A show about being seen made sure the right people were seen.

quiz.question: What made Pose groundbreaking for transgender representation?
options: It was the first show on FX
It featured the largest transgender cast and hired transgender creatives behind the camera
It won the most Emmy Awards
